# GA4 Sample Data

## Recommended references

- [Google Analytics demo account](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/6367342)
- [Google Analytics sample dataset documentation](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/10937659)
- [GA4 BigQuery export schema](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/7029846)
- [GA4 ecommerce event reference](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/ecommerce)

## Use

Use these official sources to learn event schema, nested parameters, sessionisation and BigQuery query patterns. Do not present ecommerce demo behaviour as automotive customer behaviour.
